papers.title: LoopArena: Benchmarking Models as Runtime Controllers for Loop Engineering
papers.desc: Loop Engineering is emerging as a practice for organizing development work around coding agents.

papers.title: DART-SD: Diamond-topology Aware Retrieval and Tuning for Self-Distillation of Multi-Turn Tool-Calling Agents
papers.desc: Equipping Large Language Models (LLMs) with multi-turn tool-calling capabilities is essential for building autonomous agents.

papers.title: Agentic Artifact Creation: Systems, Evaluation, Principles, and Opportunities
papers.desc: Generative models can turn natural-language prompts into images, text, code, and other content, lowering the cost of producing drafts and components.

papers.title: Puro-2B: Poor Lab's Qwen2-1.5B Trained on RTX 5090 within $5090
papers.desc: Language model pretraining has become almost synonymous with prohibitive cost, placing it out of reach for much of the academic and open-source communities.

papers.title: Act with Intent: Distilling Behavior Intent for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.desc: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models can turn multimodal context into robot actions, but their action decoders are still trained largely by behavior cloning.

papers.title: LayerRecall: A State-Conditioned Memory Router for Long-Horizon Consistency in Video Generation
papers.desc: Autoregressive video diffusion enables scalable long-video generation by producing chunks from a bounded recent context.

papers.title: Locate Anything in Videos: Rethinking Efficient Generative Spatio-Temporal Video Grounding
papers.desc: Spatio-temporal video grounding (STVG) requires models to identify when a referred event occurs and localize the target entity throughout that interval.

papers.title: Fast Weight Attention for Continual Learning
papers.desc: Recurrent fast-weight memories and selective state-space models compress an expanding context into a fixed-size recurrent state, making the state transition an online learning rule.

papers.title: Sliding-window beats linear attention
papers.desc: Due to the nature of quadratic attention, Large Language Models (LLMs) consume a lot of memory and energy.

papers.title: Ring Forcing: Towards Precise Long-Term Memory for Autoregressive Video Diffusion
papers.desc: Scaling video generation to long durations reveals a critical bottleneck: current models lack robust long-term memory.

papers.title: Language Chain in Alignment: Cross-lingual Ranking Preference Optimization
papers.desc: The alignment of Large Language Models heavily relies on English-centric high-quality preference data, which often leads to suboptimal performance in other languages.

papers.title: EvoUndo: Recoverability-Constrained Self-Evolution for LLM Agent Harnesses
papers.desc: LLM agents increasingly modify their own prompts, tools, middleware, resources, and execution harnesses at runtime.

papers.title: Generative Semantic Scene Completion
papers.desc: Outdoor LiDAR semantic scene completion (SSC) recovers a dense semantic voxel grid from a scan observing 1% of the target volume, under class imbalance beyond 7,000x.

papers.title: Lost in Compression: A Controlled Cross-Lingual Audit of Extractive Prompt Compressors
papers.desc: Extractive prompt compression promises to cut LLM inference costs by removing low-information tokens, and learned compressors such as LLMLingua-2 report strong results on English benchmarks.

papers.title: GGSS: Geodesic-Gated Spherical Steering for Inference-Time Debiasing of Generative Vision-Language Models
papers.desc: Generative vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly used in human-centered settings, yet they can produce demographically biased outputs even when images differ only in controlled attributes such as perceived race or gender.
